semiconductor_relevance: High — XINLI SEMI provides comprehensive solutions and equipment for semiconductor front-end chip manufacturing.
summary: XINLI SEMI specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for semiconductor production line equipment, focusing on the front-end chip manufacturing sector. The company offers services such as complete line planning, construction, turnkey projects, equipment refurbishment, upgrades, and spare parts development.
capabilities: Complete semiconductor equipment line planning and construction
Turnkey project execution for semiconductor manufacturing
Development and sale of semiconductor equipment spare parts

regional_presence.China: XINLI SEMI operates two factories in Shanghai and Nantong, covering approximately 5,000 square meters.
